title: Inferring Causal Relations between Two Sequences of Events with Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39406v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal AI is a branch of Artificial Intelligence which helps understand and reason about cause and effect relationships, not just patterns or correlations. Causal discovery aims to infer elements of the underlying causal structure--often represented as a directed graph--from observational and, when available, interventional data. While causal discovery is the fundamental step for moving beyond mere associations toward genuine understanding, and thus the basic building block of causal AI, it becomes intrinsically difficult when causal relations must be inferred from single observations. In such situations, standard causal discovery methods cannot be used and one has to identify causal relations from limited amount of information. This is typically the case for, e.g., sequences of events produced by different alarms which need to be analyzed on the fly to detect abnormal phenomena, which are usually rare. translated_title: 使用语言模型推断两个事件序列之间的因果关系
translated_abstract: 因果人工智能（Causal AI）是人工智能的一个分支，它帮助人们理解和推理因果关系，而不仅仅是模式或相关性。因果发现旨在从观测数据以及（在可用时）干预数据中推断潜在因果结构的要素——通常表示为有向图。虽然因果发现是超越单纯关联、走向真正理解的根本步骤，因而也是因果人工智能的基本构建模块，但当必须从单一观测中推断因果关系时，它在本质上是困难的。在这种情况下，标准的因果发现方法无法使用，人们只能从有限的信息量中识别因果关系。典型的例子如：由不同警报产生的事件序列，需要对其进行实时分析以检测通常十分罕见的异常现象。我们在这项研究中表明，……
tldr: 本研究提出利用语言模型从有限的单一观测信息（如警报产生的稀疏事件序列）中推断两个事件序列之间的因果关系，解决了标准因果发现方法在单次观测场景下失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This study proposes using language models to infer causal relations between two sequences of events from limited single-observation information (e.g., sparse event sequences generated by alarms), addressing scenarios where standard causal discovery methods fail.
